hero.subtitle: Operations & IT Department Proposal for the Group

problema.title: What does it mean to run
problema.intro: Acquiring Ca'n Ros was a strategic triumph, but operationally it multiplies stress. Traditional single-store methods create a quiet friction that drains hours of selling time every week.
problema.pain1Desc: Time is consumed by daily urgencies rather than proactive planning.
problema.pain2Desc: Prices, stock levels, and invoices cross-checked by hand between Palma and Campos.
problema.pain3Desc: Store managers spend more time typing at a desk than selling at the counter.

solucion.title1: It's not about buying more software.
solucion.desc: An in-house IT department removes mechanical drudgery: matching invoices, eyeball-checking stock, and drafting repetitive emails. Store managers get back to where they belong: serving customers.

perfil.title: The value of the Hybrid Profile
perfil.intro:
The biggest mistake companies make is separating those who design technology from those who suffer it daily. My proposal is not to be just another salesperson or a technician locked in an office.

My goal is to be the bridge between both worlds:

Someone capable of detecting the problem on the ground, and with the technical ability to solve it by creating custom tools.

mostradorItems.desc: Work in the warehouse to detect real bottlenecks in stock flows.

mostradorItems.title: Diagnose
mostradorItems.desc: Accurately identify which repetitive tasks are stealing sales time from managers.

procesosItems.desc: Deploy AI Agents to take over data processing and mechanical tasks.

procesosItems.title: Precision tools
procesosItems.desc: Develop custom IT solutions that solve specific daily problems in the store.

procesosItems.title: Data unification
procesosItems.desc: Cross-reference and analyze information from Palma and Campos to facilitate decision-making for Management.

garantias.title: Three guarantees
garantias.desc: Technology exists to add agility, never to create uncertainty. Every automation is built around safety, control, and zero friction for Management.
garantias.g1Desc: No process runs autonomously. Technology creates suggestions and drafts; final validation is always yours.
garantias.g2Desc: POS, ERP, and banking are managed by certified providers. I add automation and intelligence layers without altering the core.
garantias.g3Desc: Any implemented tool can be toggled on or off in seconds. Operations never stop or depend on a single tool.

bloques.title: Architecture of
bloques.desc: The entire work plan is organized following the company's real structure. At the top, a <bold>Global Headquarters</bold> unifies the strategy and resources of both hardware stores. Below, each store operates on three identical pillars (<bold>Administration, Customers and Operations</bold>). To ensure maximum security, any innovation is first implemented in the Ca'n Ros environment and, only after proving its effectiveness, cloned to Son Garrit.

areas.title: 15 areas.
areas.desc: Each area of the business has 10 specific proposals analyzed. From Ca'n Ros's purchases to the delivery van's route.
areas.a01Desc: Forecasting automation and alerts to avoid stockouts.
areas.a02Desc: Local cash register control, reconciliations and daily invoicing.
areas.a03Desc: Dashboard and KPIs exclusive to the store's performance.
areas.a04Desc: General strategy and supervision of the holding.
areas.a07Desc: Global control of cash flow and profitability.
areas.a08Desc: Positioning and differentiated marketing by area.
areas.a10Desc: Transfer of efficient processes from Palma to Campos.
areas.a12Desc: Shift management, payroll and staff productivity.
areas.a13Desc: Theft prevention, access control and video surveillance.

viabilidad.title: A candid reality
viabilidad.desc: Not everything is free or immediate. Total transparency regarding costs, timelines, and risks.
viabilidad.inversion75: Covered by hybrid internal role (no-code tools, standard AI models)
viabilidad.inversion25: Requires external investment (certified ERP/POS specialist, licenses)
viabilidad.tiempoNota: Humans remain essential in the loop. We just stop wasting time typing repetitive data.
viabilidad.riesgo1: Zero risk. Systems strictly prepare drafts for human approval.
viabilidad.riesgo2: 100% reversible. Can be turned off within 1 minute.
viabilidad.riesgo3: Month one will focus on cleaning catalog codes and price matrices.
